event_detail: Steak on the plate: the gripper comes down onto the steak (33.6-35.2 s), then closes and lifts away toward the cutting board (36.8-38.4 s) with the steak left on the plate.
evidence: The knife lies on the cutting board throughout (stage 1 done). Wrist view at 35.2 s: the steak fills the space between the fingers. At 36.8 and 38.4 s the fingers are together and empty, and the plate with the steak still on it shrinks into the corner of the image as the arm moves toward the board. The shoulder views also show the steak still on the plate at 38.4 s.
